segment.source: Renders a bundle: everything inside it, the bundled price, and what the same items would cost bought apart. The saving is the whole argument, so it gets a badge and a line of its own. Use it for: a starter kit of several products, a course-plus-book package, a retainer that folds in hosting and support, a seasonal set. Prefer 'Plan Card' when the packages are tiers of one product, and 'Add-On List' when the extras are picked one at a time.
